title: C-reactive protein predicted effector genes (Said S et al. 2022)
bodyHtml:
This table displays results from the study:

Genetic analysis of over half a million people characterises C-reactive protein loci.
Said S, et al.
Nat Commun. 2022 Apr 22;13(1):2198. doi: 10.1038/s41467-022-29650-5.
PMID: 35459240

The authors performed a GWAS meta-analysis of genetic associations for C-reactive protein (CRP) levels, which indicate the extent of systemic inflammation, in 575,531 individuals of European ancestry. To prioritize potential effector genes at the GWAS significant loci, they applied the FUMA method (Watanabe et al. 2017), which includes positional, eQTL, and chromatin interaction mapping, and also performed MAGMA analysis to generate gene-level association scores. The table below includes one row for each gene in a GWAS significant locus.
